CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Inspired Word of God.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Samson kills a Lion? (1 mark)
   A. Use Samson kills a Lion to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Samson kills a Lion has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Samson kills a Lion.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of God? (1 mark)

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

7. Which response best shows understanding of Thoughts and feelings? (1 mark)

   D. Use Thoughts and feelings to insult classmates of other faiths.

   B. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
